name: PIMS Evalu Pro (Copy Checker)
highlights: Converts uploaded PDFs to per-page images, generates processed PDFs, and syncs with Google Drive.
Processed 8000+ copies with zero downtime via PM2 during peak evaluation cycles.
Self-hosted on a shared Oracle server behind an Nginx reverse proxy.

name: EaseExit
description: Backend for the college leave management app — digitizes and automates leave applications and approvals.
highlights: Replaced a paper-based leave process with role-based access for students, parents, wardens, guards and admins.
Multi-level approvals, document uploads, and push notifications via Firebase Cloud Messaging.
Handled 15,000+ leave applications across web, Android and iOS.

name: Elective Registration
description: Elective course registration portal for students.
highlights: Google OAuth + JWT auth, with Student and Admin dashboards.
Bulk student upload via CSV/Excel, and PDF/Excel report generation.
FCFS allocation using MongoDB atomic transactions allotted 500+ seats across 50+ courses without overbooking.

name: Status Dashboard
description: Public service status page and protected infrastructure monitoring dashboard.
highlights: Public dashboard with WebSocket-driven real-time server health, uptime/downtime tracking and resource utilization.
Centralized log aggregation via polling, and a JWT-secured admin panel.
Automated MongoDB backups to Google Drive.
